profile:
### Bulk Biceps — G4 stallion

**Who he is:** The comically muscle-bound white Pegasus with tiny wings, red eyes, a short blond mane, gold ear hoops, a black dumbbell cutie mark, and a booming **“YEAH!”** He is especially recognizable as the slow-but-enthusiastic third flier on Rainbow Dash and Fluttershy’s Ponyville relay team in *Rainbow Falls*. Despite his intimidating build, he is cheerful and easily startled by butterflies.

**Name history:** **Bulk Biceps** is his established show name, spoken in *Rainbow Falls* (2014). Before that, fans used **Snowflake** and **Roid Rage**; the 2013 *Elements of Harmony* guide called him **“Muscle Pony.”** IDW artist Andy Price used “Snowflake” when describing [his 2012 comic page](https://www.deviantart.com/andypriceart/art/MLP-FIM-Page-3-issue-1-332168960), while a December 2013 [report on an Enterplay collectible card](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2013/12/snowflake-officially-named-bulk-biceps.html) documents the name Bulk Biceps before its on-screen introduction. These are earlier labels, **not** secret identities.

**Appearances and voice:** First seen shouting in *Hurricane Fluttershy* (2012); later a *Wonderbolts Academy* trainee, an *Equestria Games* relay competitor, a Ponyville spa masseur, and a weightlifting mentor in *On Your Marks*. He also appears in the 2017 film, IDW comics, and *Pony Life*. **He speaks:** director **Jayson Thiessen** supplied early shouts, while **Michael Dobson** voiced more substantial dialogue, including *Rainbow Falls*. His *Equestria Girls* human counterpart belongs to that separate setting, not an alter ego. [Episode and character details](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Bulk_Biceps).
